random-generator-api-concept.title: Use the RandomGenerator API
random-generator-api-concept.short: Choose random generators through a common API
random-generator-api-concept.summary: RandomGenerator is the common random-number-generator interface introduced in Java 17.
random-generator-api-concept.why: Code can use common generation operations without depending directly on one concrete random algorithm class.
random-generator-api-concept.tips: Match the generator to the required properties; use SecureRandom rather than a general RandomGenerator for security-sensitive randomness.

charset-decoder-concept.title: Decode bytes with CharsetDecoder
charset-decoder-concept.short: Decode text while controlling malformed-input behavior
charset-decoder-concept.summary: CharsetDecoder converts byte sequences into Unicode characters according to a specific Charset.
charset-decoder-concept.why: It provides explicit control over malformed or otherwise problematic input beyond a simple String construction.
charset-decoder-concept.tips: Verify the actual source encoding and choose an explicit malformed-input policy when needed.

string-indent-method.title: Indent lines with String.indent
string-indent-method.short: Apply consistent indentation to every line of a string
string-indent-method.summary: String.indent adds spaces to each line for positive values and removes indentation for negative values.
string-indent-method.why: It expresses multiline indentation without a manual line-processing loop.
string-indent-method.tips: The method also normalizes line termination, so check its contract when original line endings must be preserved exactly.

string-transform.title: Pass a string through String.transform
string-transform.short: Feed a string directly into a transformation function
string-transform.summary: String.transform passes the string itself to a function and returns that function's result.
string-transform.why: It can connect string processing to a result of another type without introducing an intermediate variable.
string-transform.tips: Keep inline transformations small; extract complex behavior into a named method for readability.

malformed-input-exception.title: MalformedInputException
malformed-input-exception.short: Handle byte sequences that are invalid for the selected charset
malformed-input-exception.summary: MalformedInputException reports input that a decoder cannot interpret as a valid byte sequence for its Charset.
malformed-input-exception.why: It exposes encoding mismatches or damaged input instead of silently treating invalid bytes as ordinary text.
malformed-input-exception.tips: Confirm the source Charset and configure CodingErrorAction when replacement rather than reporting is intended.

unmappable-character-exception.title: UnmappableCharacterException
unmappable-character-exception.short: Handle characters that the target charset cannot represent
unmappable-character-exception.summary: UnmappableCharacterException reports a valid character for which an encoder cannot produce bytes in the target Charset.
unmappable-character-exception.why: It detects information loss when writing Unicode text to a restricted encoding such as ASCII.
unmappable-character-exception.tips: Choose a charset that represents the required characters or explicitly configure replacement/reporting behavior.

record-instance-field-error.title: Records cannot declare extra instance fields
record-instance-field-error.short: Use record components or computed methods instead
record-instance-field-error.summary: A record defines its instance state in its header and cannot declare additional instance fields in the record body.
record-instance-field-error.why: The record model keeps its state and generated equality, hashing, and string representation tied to record components.
record-instance-field-error.tips: Add persistent state as a component; expose derived values through methods.

annotation-element-type-error.title: Annotation elements require permitted value types
annotation-element-type-error.short: Arbitrary reference types such as Object are not annotation element types
annotation-element-type-error.summary: Annotation elements are limited to primitive types, String, Class, enum, annotation types, and one-dimensional arrays of permitted types.
annotation-element-type-error.why: Annotation values must fit the fixed forms that can be represented in class-file annotation metadata.
annotation-element-type-error.tips: Represent metadata with identifiers, Class values, enums, or other permitted annotation values rather than arbitrary objects.

synchronization-value-based-warning.title: Do not synchronize on value-based objects
synchronization-value-based-warning.short: Use a dedicated identity object as a monitor
synchronization-value-based-warning.summary: javac's synchronization lint can warn when a value-based class such as Integer is used as a synchronized monitor.
synchronization-value-based-warning.why: Value-based objects are not intended for identity-sensitive synchronization, and equal values do not define a stable lock identity.
synchronization-value-based-warning.tips: Use a dedicated lock such as a private final Object instead.

identityhashmap-equals-trap.title: IdentityHashMap compares keys by identity
identityhashmap-equals-trap.short: Use HashMap when keys should follow equals
identityhashmap-equals-trap.summary: IdentityHashMap compares keys by reference identity rather than by equals.
identityhashmap-equals-trap.why: It is intended for specialized identity-based algorithms, so equal but distinct objects become different keys.
identityhashmap-equals-trap.tips: Reserve IdentityHashMap for identity semantics such as object-graph processing; use HashMap for ordinary dictionaries.
